enable.title: Enable force update
enable.hint: When enabled, apps below the minimum version are blocked and an update dialog is shown.

message.label: Update message
message.placeholder: A new version of the app is available. Please update the app to continue.

warnings.iosStoreEmpty: The iOS store link is empty — during a forced update, users won't be able to open the App Store.
warnings.inert: The minimum and latest versions are the same — nobody is below the minimum, so the forced update will never trigger. Raise the minimum version when a new version is released.
